<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="100%" height="100%">
  <rect width="400" height="400" fill="#120b08" />
  <!-- Rombo ruotato -->
  <g transform="translate(200, 200) rotate(45)">
    <rect x="-90" y="-90" width="180" height="180" fill="none" stroke="#ff2200" stroke-width="12" stroke-dasharray="260 10" opacity="0.9" />
    <rect x="-75" y="-75" width="150" height="150" fill="#050305" opacity="0.7" />
  </g>
  <!-- Asse secante di ADE che taglia il rombo -->
  <line x1="110" y1="320" x2="290" y2="80" stroke="#e85d04" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Nucleo centrale del punto esclamativo decostruito in coordinate di fase -->
  <circle cx="200" cy="175" r="6" fill="#ff7b00" />
  <circle cx="200" cy="230" r="6" fill="#ff7b00" />
  <text x="200" y="370" text-anchor="middle" fill="#888" font-family="monospace" font-size="11" letter-spacing="2">CRITICITÀ NON ORGANICA: ∇E > 0</text>
</svg>
